approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce synonym misses and substring false matches before changing retrieval.
Use a capped audited local vocabulary; do not add embeddings, a vector service or a model call.
Keep direct question terms stronger than equivalents and never add opposite dispositions.
Validate with synthetic offline evidence only.
title: Add bounded construction terminology to project questions
objective: Recover exact RFI, Submittal and Email evidence when the user's wording differs, without semantic overreach or another service.
